modules.name: ontologylab.method_commands
modules.rationale: Human decide() is the only Method review-write path for occurrence/fragment/link/bridge/gap decisions.

secondary_stages.why: propose_fragment/propose_link/propose_bridge assemble Method IR instead of living in a synthesize-only module.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Missing review_event_id is silently minted via uuid4 instead of requiring an explicit receipt id.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_compiler
modules.rationale: compile_method is the method-compile stage: snapshot -> gated canonical method.json + receipt.

secondary_stages.why: validate_final_artifacts is the G8 integrity check, a verify-shaped gate living inside compile.

hidden_fallbacks.what: provisional_g8 = gate_result(G8, ()) always passes; preview and first assemble treat G8 as success.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_compiler_artifacts
modules.rationale: build_method emits the compiled Method JSON/source-index dicts that later stages persist and pack.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Unselected compile defaults release version to 1.
Missing workspace name falls back to method_id.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_compiler_contract
modules.rationale: Typed compile boundary: GateId G0-G8 and CompilerReceipt shared by gates, replay, and persistence.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_compiler_gates
modules.rationale: evaluate_source_gates runs non-compensatory G0-G6 as the compile-gate transformation.

secondary_stages.why: G6 checks human review receipts and reviewer identity, a Verify concern inside compile.

hidden_fallbacks.what: g8() is defined but never called; compile uses always-pass provisional G8 plus validate_final_artifacts instead.
G6 infers human-ness from reviewer string prefixes/suffixes rather than an explicit actor type.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_compiler_replay
modules.rationale: evaluate_replay is compile gate G7: bounded competency/replay fixtures over compiled method JSON.

secondary_stages.why: ReplayReceipt is a grounding/competency check, Verify-shaped, owned by the compiler.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_extract
modules.rationale: extract_occurrences is a second LLM extract pipeline producing StatementOccurrence proposals.

secondary_stages.why: _policy_allows fail-closes on unresolved source-policy snapshots before engine calls.

hidden_fallbacks.what: MockEngine has no method-occurrence marker; method extract on mock falls through to KG _mock_extraction.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_extraction_store
modules.rationale: MethodExtractionStore is the extraction-run/chunk/occurrence persistence facade over method_sql_extraction.

secondary_stages.why: Public API is the Extract-stage write surface (import_occurrence, claim/succeed/fail chunk/run).

hidden_fallbacks.what: fail_extraction_run is implemented but has zero external callers; extract path only fails chunks.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_gaps
modules.rationale: detect_gaps is the deterministic Gap step: frozen snapshot -> typed gap proposals.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_ir
modules.rationale: Typed MethodIR dataclasses/enums plus parse_method; schema/models, not a pipeline transform.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_ir_codec
modules.rationale: 1002-LOC MethodIRCodec is the import-only typed JSON dialect behind parse_method; unused by compile emit.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_mcp
modules.rationale: MethodPackReader is the read-only MCP query surface: list/get/trace/list_method_gaps over packed rows.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_mcp_publication
modules.rationale: publication_authority binds MCP reads to the packed methodology publication receipt.

secondary_stages.why: Re-validates pack publication hashes/selection; Publish contract checked again at Consume time.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_mcp_queries
modules.rationale: Typed MCP query envelopes and input bounds (list/get/trace/gaps) with no storage of its own.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_mcp_rows
modules.rationale: canonical_row/release_payloads validate packed compiled_method rows on the MCP read path.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_mcp_sql
modules.rationale: Separate read-only SQLite owner for compiled_method tables; a second MethodPackSql class.

secondary_stages.why: Only consumed by MethodPackReader MCP queries.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_pack
modules.rationale: copy_method_releases copies selected method_release rows into the immutable pack and builds the methodology manifest.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_pack_contract
modules.rationale: Typed pack-selection boundary (schema/compiler versions + MethodPackSelection) for methodology-v1 publication.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_pack_rows
modules.rationale: method_row/source_rows assemble canonical pack table tuples from a selected release.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_pack_sql
modules.rationale: MethodPackSql owns pack-build SQL (read working method_release, write compiled_method); parallel SQL layer.

secondary_stages.why: SQL adapter used only by copy_method_releases during pack build.

hidden_fallbacks.what: snapshot_hash opens a nested MethodUnitOfWork+MethodStore during pack copy instead of a pure SQL read.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_pack_validation
modules.rationale: validate_method_pack is the pack-side G8-equivalent: packed tables must match selection hashes and schema.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_release_store
modules.rationale: MethodReleaseStore persists compilation attempts/gates and insert_release of immutable method_release rows.

secondary_stages.why: ReleasePersistence protocol is a storage adapter; SQL lives in method_sql_release.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_release_validation
modules.rationale: canonical_release_envelope is the sole hash-binding of method JSON + source index + compiler receipt.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_snapshot
modules.rationale: MethodSnapshot/MethodSnapshotStore freeze workspace rows to canonical JSON for compile/review; storage view.

secondary_stages.why: read_compilation_snapshot is the compiler's input boundary.

hidden_fallbacks.what: create_workspace always writes status 'draft'; no transition to review_ready/compiled/superseded exists.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_snapshot_payload
modules.rationale: Pure snapshot_payload assembly from SnapshotRows; no I/O, no stage transform of its own.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_sql_core
modules.rationale: Private SQLite owner for workspace/policy/fragment/link/bridge/decision writes; parallel to kgstore.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_sql_extraction
modules.rationale: Private SQLite owner for statement_occurrence and extraction run/chunk state; duplicates document lookup SQL.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_sql_release
modules.rationale: Private SQLite owner for compilation_attempt/gate, method_release, and snapshot loads.

secondary_stages.why: Persists compiler receipts and releases that pack copy later publishes.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_store
modules.rationale: Mega-facade: DDL, MethodUnitOfWork, and mixin of validation/commands/extraction/release/snapshot over three SQL cores.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_uow
modules.rationale: UnitOfWorkState tracks transaction lifecycle only; actual BEGIN/commit lives in method_store.MethodUnitOfWork.

modules.name: ontologylab.method_validation
modules.rationale: Shared Method error types, id/hash validators, and persistence record dataclasses; schema/safety helpers.

secondary_stages.why: create_source_policy writes the rights/allowlist records that method extract consults.

findings: Second pipeline, not a reused stage: documents->StatementOccurrence->Fragment->Gap->Bridge->decide->gates->pack->MCP duplicates Extract (ontologylab/method_extract.py:122 vs ontologylab/extractor.py), Verify (ontologylab/method_commands.py:235 decide vs KG review), Publish (ontologylab/method_pack.py:266 vs ontologylab/packbuilder.py:392 and ontologylab/packbuilder.py:599), Consume (ontologylab/method_mcp.py:55 vs mcp_server graph tools), and storage (ontologylab/method_sql_core.py:135, ontologylab/method_sql_extraction.py:121, ontologylab/method_sql_release.py:151, ontologylab/method_pack_sql.py:16, ontologylab/method_mcp_sql.py:15 vs kgstore). Architecture promised reuse of extractor/engines/pack/MCP seams (docs/METHODOLOGY-COMPILER-ARCHITECTURE.md section 10) but shipped a parallel 31-file/8983-LOC stack.

CONFIRMED dual schema (docs/ENGINE-PIPELINE-AUDIT-2026-08-19.md item 9): compile emit is a loose dict at ontologylab/method_compiler_artifacts.py:185 (payload copied from payload_json at ontologylab/method_compiler_artifacts.py:138, never parse_method/MethodIR). Typed dialect is MethodIR at ontologylab/method_ir.py:205 with MethodFragment.payload Mapping[str, TypedValue] at ontologylab/method_ir.py:118, decoded only by MethodIRCodec.parse_method at ontologylab/method_ir_codec.py:863 (module is 1002 LOC; sole importer ontologylab/method_ir.py:14). compile_method at ontologylab/method_compiler.py:189 calls build_method, not parse_method; parse_method is CLI import-only (ontologylab/main.py:103). Dual unit tables: ontologylab/method_ir_codec.py:19 _UNITS vs ontologylab/method_compiler_gates.py:20 _UNIT_DIMENSIONS (codec has K/L/%/1, gates has h).

Entrypoints: CLI ontologylab/main.py:122 cmd_method, subparser method at ontologylab/main.py:351 (extract/workspace-create/policy-*/occurrence-import/fragment-import/link-import/bridge-import/review/detect-gaps/compile/decide); build-pack --method-release-id wired through ontologylab/packbuilder.py:392 and ontologylab/packbuilder.py:599 copy_method_releases. MCP PackSession list_methods/get_method/trace_method at ontologylab/mcp_server.py:425, ontologylab/mcp_server.py:432, ontologylab/mcp_server.py:439 plus list_method_gaps at ontologylab/mcp_server.py:449; FastMCP tools at ontologylab/mcp_server.py:1228, ontologylab/mcp_server.py:1236, ontologylab/mcp_server.py:1244, ontologylab/mcp_server.py:1252; resources pack://{pack_id}/method/{method_id} at ontologylab/mcp_server.py:1287 and trace at ontologylab/mcp_server.py:1298. kgstore opens schema at ontologylab/kgstore.py:914. No HTTP routes under ontologylab/server/ for method workspace or compile.

Hollow/implicit compile+lifecycle: ontologylab/method_compiler_gates.py:497 g8() has zero callers; ontologylab/method_compiler.py:212 inserts always-pass provisional G8. ontologylab/method_snapshot.py:214 freezes workspace status at draft despite ontologylab/method_store.py:56 CHECK allowing review_ready/compiled/superseded. ontologylab/method_extraction_store.py:335 fail_extraction_run has no callers outside its SQL twin. Declared method_bridges.py (architecture section 10) does not exist; bridges enter only via CLI bridge-import (ontologylab/main.py:204) / MethodCommands.propose_bridge at ontologylab/method_commands.py:186.

Overlapping routing and mega-modules: two classes named MethodPackSql (ontologylab/method_pack_sql.py:16 write vs ontologylab/method_mcp_sql.py:15 read). ontologylab/method_store.py:631 mixes five command mixins plus MethodUnitOfWork at ontologylab/method_store.py:586 while ontologylab/method_uow.py:8 holds only state. ontologylab/method_commands.py:82 owns both Synthesize proposals (ontologylab/method_commands.py:94 and ontologylab/method_commands.py:186) and Verify decide (ontologylab/method_commands.py:235). ontologylab/method_compiler_gates.py:14 imports private method_gaps._dependency_cycles and re-runs cycle detection at ontologylab/method_compiler_gates.py:366, a cross-stage shortcut. Duplicate canonical_hash at ontologylab/method_compiler_gates.py:31 and ontologylab/method_pack_validation.py:32. Duplicate COMPILER_VERSION at ontologylab/method_compiler_artifacts.py:27 and ontologylab/method_pack_contract.py:9. Duplicate _SELECT_DOCUMENT at ontologylab/method_sql_core.py:32 and ontologylab/method_sql_extraction.py:42.

Engine slot is nameable only on Extract: ontologylab.models.Engine at ontologylab/models.py:285, insertion ontologylab/method_extract.py:220 engine.generate. Compiler is correctly LLM-free. MockEngine at ontologylab/engines.py:514 has no method-occurrence-v1 branch, so the replaceable slot's default mock implementation is a hidden fallback into KG extraction JSON.

G6 reviewer heuristic at ontologylab/method_compiler_gates.py:484 accepts any name in {human,reviewer} or prefixed human-/reviewer- / suffixed -reviewer, a string-shape stand-in for a typed human actor; ontologylab/method_commands.py:286 also auto-mints review_event_id.
